runbooks.title: Elevated 5xx after a deploy
runbooks.body: If error rate rises within 30 minutes of a deploy, roll back the deploy first, then investigate. Check connection pool exhaustion and downstream timeouts.

runbooks.title: High CPU saturation
runbooks.body: If CPU is above 85 percent with normal error rate, scale up the service by one step and check for a traffic spike or a hot loop.

runbooks.title: Queue backlog on workers
runbooks.body: If queue depth grows while error rate is flat, restart the worker service and check for stuck consumers.
